# Reference

Every concept of the approach, its type and definition, and the checks that hold it, generated from [ontology.md](../ontology.md) and [checks.md](../checks.md). Automatic checks are enforced by the tool; manual checks are what a reviewer does, because the tool cannot. The pages of this directory explain the parts; this page is what they refer to.

## Specification

| Kind   | Term                          | ID                       | Type | Definition                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| ------ | ----------------------------- | ------------------------ | ---- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Entity | Specification                 | `ent.specification`      |      | The ontology and the check catalogue of a product together: what a model writes the product's code from, the mockup included.                                                                                           |
| Rule   | Specification is the source   | `rule.spec-is-source`    |      | A model writes the product's code from the specification, and the mockup is code written the same way; what the code does that the specification does not say is a gap in the specification.                            |
| Rule   | Behavior in the specification | `rule.behavior-in-spec`  |      | The specification describes behavior as completely as it can: what every view shows in each state, what the user can do there, and every outcome of every action as a check. Layout and style are the implementation's. |
| Rule   | Specification changes first   | `rule.change-spec-first` |      | A change of behavior starts in the specification, then the checks, then the code and its tests; a change of code alone changes no behavior.                                                                             |

| Check                                    | Concepts                 | GIVEN                                      | WHEN                                          | THEN                                                                                                                                         | Proof  |
| ---------------------------------------- | ------------------------ | ------------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------ |
| `check.specification.code-from-spec`     | `rule.spec-is-source`    | a slice of code, the mockup included       | a reviewer compares it with the specification | everything it does is stated by a definition row or a check; what is not becomes a check or a question before the slice is done              | manual |
| `check.specification.behavior-described` | `rule.behavior-in-spec`  | a view or an action                        | a reviewer reads its rows and its checks      | what the view shows in each state, what the user can do there and every outcome of the action are stated; layout and style are not asked for | manual |
| `check.specification.changed-first`      | `rule.change-spec-first` | a change that alters what the product does | a reviewer reads its commits                  | the ontology or the catalogue changes in the same change or before the code                                                                  | manual |

| `check.decision.names-superseded`             | `inv.supersession-named`                                                                                | an entry that replaces an earlier one                                                                                                                                                        | a reviewer reads it                                          | it names the entries it supersedes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | manual |
| `check.decision.meaning-change-decided`       | `inv.meaning-change-decided`                                                                            | a change to the ontology that rests on a choice                                                                                                                                              | a reviewer reads the change                                  | a decision entry records the choice                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | manual |
| `check.decision.source-followed`              | `rule.source-precedence`                                                                                | the owner's message and an answer a colleague gave for the owner disagree about one choice                                                                                                   | the entry is written                                         | it follows the owner's message and names it on its `Source:` line; an entry resting only on the colleague's answer is tentative                                                                                                                                       | manual |
| `check.decision.question-as-tentative`        | `rule.question-as-tentative`                                                                            | a question with options and a recommendation                                                                                                                                                 | it is written down                                           | it is a tentative entry whose decision is the recommendation and whose rejected alternatives are the other options, not a line under open questions                                                                                                                   | manual |
| `check.decision.run-settles-question`         | `rule.run-settles-question`                                                                             | a tentative entry or an open question waits for the owner                                                                                                                                    | a reviewer reads it                                          | it asks what no run can settle; a question about speed, fit or behavior carries the result of a prototype instead of waiting                                                                                                                                          | manual |
| `check.decision.answer-recorded`              | `action.answer-tentative`                                                                               | the owner answers a tentative entry                                                                                                                                                          | the log is updated                                           | the entry is accepted as written or as rewritten to the chosen option and names the answer on its `Source:` line, and History records the acceptance; the entry of a dropped question is removed, and History says so                                                 | manual |
| `check.decision.deferral-returns`             | `rule.deferral-returns`                                                                                 | something is put off: a target concept or an item out of scope                                                                                                                               | a reviewer reads the change                                  | an entry defers it with a `Return when:` line                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | manual |

## Implementation row

| Kind      | Term                    | ID                                | Type             | Definition                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| --------- | ----------------------- | --------------------------------- | ---------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Entity    | Implementation row      | `ent.implementation-row`          |                  | A claim that one or more concepts exist in the product, with the files and a note on what is partial.                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Field     | Files                   | `field.implementation-row.files`  | text             | Paths of the files that realise the concept.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |

| Relation  | Concepts                | `edge.implementation-row.concept` | refs ent.concept | The concepts the row claims; concepts realised in the same files may share a row.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Derived   | Named in code           | `derived.named-in-code`           |                  | The files that name a concept in an ont: comment: those of the implementation table and of the code directories the configuration lists; --coverage shows them, and the check lists implemented concepts that the files of their row do not name, as information unless the configuration requires names (inv.implemented-named). |
| Rule      | Code names its concepts | `rule.code-names-concepts`        |                  | Code that implements a concept names its ID next to it in a comment, // ont: inv.no-renew-when-held; a name is not an implementation, so the implementation table still says where a concept is built.                                                                                                                            |
| Rule      | Updated with the code   | `rule.table-with-code`            |                  | A change to behavior updates the implementation table in the same change.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Rule      | Partial noted           | `rule.partial-noted`              |                  | The note of a partial row names the target concept that adds what is missing; no note means complete as far as the author knows.                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Invariant | Code names resolve      | `inv.code-names-resolve`          |                  | Every ID that code names in an ont: comment is defined and not retired.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Invariant | Files exist             | `inv.implementation-files-exist`  |                  | Every file the table names exists.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Invariant | Row is true             | `inv.implementation-true`         |                  | The files a row names do realise the concept.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Invariant | Implemented is named    | `inv.implemented-named`           |                  | When the configuration sets codeNames.require, every implemented concept is named in an ont: comment in a file of its row, so a cleanup that deletes the name fails the check.                                                                                                                                                    |

| Check                                          | Concepts                                     | GIVEN                                                                                                                                                              | WHEN                                | THEN                                                                                                                                  | Proof  |
| ---------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------ |
| `check.implementation-row.missing-file`        | `inv.implementation-files-exist`             | a row names a file that does not exist                                                                                                                             | the check runs                      | it names the file and fails                                                                                                           | auto   |
| `check.implementation-row.grouped`             | `edge.implementation-row.concept`            | `edge.loan.item` and `edge.loan.member` share one row with one file                                                                                                | the check runs                      | both count as implemented                                                                                                             | auto   |
| `check.implementation-row.code-name-unknown`   | `inv.code-names-resolve`                     | `app/library.mjs` names, in an `ont:` comment, an ID the ontology does not define, and elsewhere uses a property path that looks like an ID without such a comment | the check runs                      | it names the ID and the file, and fails; the code without the comment is not read                                                     | auto   |
| `check.implementation-row.code-name-retired`   | `inv.code-names-resolve`                     | `app/library.mjs` names `field.due-date`, which the ontology retired for `field.loan.due-date`                                                                     | the check runs                      | it names the ID and its replacement, and fails                                                                                        | auto   |
| `check.implementation-row.unnamed-in-code`     | `derived.named-in-code`                      | `derived.queue-position` is implemented in `app/library.mjs`, and the file does not name it                                                                        | the check runs, then `--coverage`   | it lists `derived.queue-position` as information and passes; `--coverage` shows, for each implemented concept, the files that name it | auto   |
| `check.implementation-row.unnamed-required`    | `inv.implemented-named`                      | the configuration sets `codeNames.require`, and `app/library.mjs`, the file of the row of `derived.queue-position`, does not name it                               | the check runs                      | it fails and names `derived.queue-position`                                                                                           | auto   |
| `check.implementation-row.updated-with-code`   | `rule.table-with-code`, `rule.partial-noted` | a change to behavior                                                                                                                                               | a reviewer reads it                 | the implementation table changed in the same change, and the note of a partial row names the target concept that adds what is missing | manual |
| `check.implementation-row.true`                | `inv.implementation-true`                    | a row of the implementation table                                                                                                                                  | a reviewer opens the files it names | they realise the concept                                                                                                              | manual |
| `check.implementation-row.code-names-concepts` | `rule.code-names-concepts`                   | code that implements a concept                                                                                                                                     | a reviewer reads it                 | an `ont:` comment next to the code names the concept                                                                                  | manual |

## Divergence

| Kind      | Term                   | ID                              | Type             | Definition                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| --------- | ---------------------- | ------------------------------- | ---------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Entity    | Divergence             | `ent.divergence`                |                  | A place where the product does something the target does not want.                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| Field     | Description            | `field.divergence.description`  | text             | What the product does instead, and the ticket or decision that will settle it.                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Relation  | Concepts               | `edge.divergence.concepts`      | refs ent.concept | The concepts involved.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Rule      | Only contradictions    | `rule.divergence-contradicts`   |                  | A divergence records behavior that contradicts the target; what is not built yet is the gap, not a divergence.                                                                                                                                                   |
| Rule      | Becomes work           | `rule.divergence-becomes-work`  |                  | Each divergence becomes a ticket, or a decision when the target was what changed.                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Rule      | Second vocabulary      | `rule.second-vocabulary`        |                  | A project may keep the vocabulary of what shipped apart from the target's; where they disagree, it is a divergence, never a silent edit of either.                                                                                                               |
| Invariant | Concepts named         | `inv.divergence-names-concepts` |                  | Every line under known divergences names at least one concept by ID.                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Action    | Walk the product blind | `action.walk-blind`             |                  | Use the product as a user, from the ontology, the catalogue, the map and the run guides but not the code: behavior that contradicts the target becomes a known divergence, a case the catalogue lacks becomes a check, and what is not built is already the gap. |

| Check                                  | Concepts                                                 | GIVEN                                                                                                                                                | WHEN                        | THEN                                                                                                                                                             | Proof  |
| -------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------ |
| `check.divergence.no-concept`          | `inv.divergence-names-concepts`                          | a line under known divergences names no concept by ID                                                                                                | the check runs              | it quotes the line and fails                                                                                                                                     | auto   |
| `check.divergence.walk-blind`          | `action.walk-blind`                                      | a blind walk found that renewal goes through while someone waits, that the hold queue is not served, and that nothing says what a damaged item shows | a reviewer reads its report | the walker had no access to the code; the renewal became a known divergence, the case of the damaged item a check, and the queue nothing new, since it is target | manual |
| `check.divergence.only-contradictions` | `rule.divergence-contradicts`                            | a new line under known divergences                                                                                                                   | a reviewer reads it         | it describes behavior that contradicts the target, not something missing                                                                                         | manual |
| `check.divergence.becomes-work`        | `rule.divergence-becomes-work`, `rule.second-vocabulary` | a known divergence                                                                                                                                   | a reviewer reads the list   | it points at a ticket or a pending decision, and neither side was edited to hide it                                                                              | manual |

| `check.mockup-element.tooltips-stale`           | `inv.tooltips-generated`                      | the tooltip file was edited by hand                                    | the check runs                           | it names the file and fails                                                           | auto   |

| `check.mockup-element.fictional-data`           | `rule.mockup-data-fictional`                  | a mockup shared outside the team                                       | a reviewer reads its data                | it holds no real names or records                                                     | manual |

## Check

| Kind      | Term                     | ID                              | Type                        | Definition                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| --------- | ------------------------ | ------------------------------- | --------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Entity    | Check                    | `ent.check`                     |                             | A case with data that must hold for any implementation, in the product's terms.                                                                                                                                            |
| Field     | GIVEN                    | `field.check.given`             | text                        | The state to start from.                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Field     | WHEN                     | `field.check.when`              | text                        | The event.                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Field     | THEN                     | `field.check.then`              | text                        | The observable result.                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Field     | Proof                    | `field.check.proof`             | one of auto, judged, manual | auto when a test implements it, judged when a test runs it and a model judges the output against its THEN, manual when only a person or an agent with the product can. auto and judged checks are automatic.               |
| Relation  | Proves                   | `edge.check.concepts`           | refs ent.concept            | The concepts the check proves.                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Concept   | Ontology layer           | `concept.ontology-layer`        |                             | What the tool checks in any project: the ontology and the artifacts that refer to it.                                                                                                                                      |
| Concept   | Product layer            | `concept.product-layer`         |                             | What a project's catalogue and tests check: the product that agents build from the ontology.                                                                                                                               |
| Concept   | Completeness axis        | `concept.completeness-axis`     |                             | A fork along which behavior diverges, with its values. Every action has the outcome axis: success, refusal, empty, error, silence; a project may add axes of its own.                                                      |
| Rule      | In the product's terms   | `rule.check-in-product-terms`   |                             | GIVEN, WHEN and THEN use concrete data from a fixed sample and the product's words; no function names, commands or selectors.                                                                                              |
| Rule      | Unreachable reported     | `rule.unreachable-reported`     |                             | A manual check that could not be run is reported as not run, never verified through another path.                                                                                                                          |
| Rule      | Evidence kept            | `rule.manual-evidence-kept`     |                             | Evidence of a manual check is kept outside the repository, named by check and date.                                                                                                                                        |
| Rule      | Chosen values checked    | `rule.chosen-value-checked`     |                             | A value a decision chose, or a target that is a requirement, is held by an automatic check; a model's assumptions are held by a snapshot of its base scenario's results, never by a check that the model reaches its goal. |
| Rule      | The judge sees the check | `rule.judge-sees-the-check`     |                             | A judge gets the check's GIVEN, WHEN and THEN and the product's output, not the code or the test.                                                                                                                          |
| Rule      | Verdict kept             | `rule.verdict-kept`             |                             | The verdict of a judged check is kept outside the repository, named by check and date, like the evidence of a manual check.                                                                                                |
| Rule      | No redundant check       | `rule.check-not-redundant`      |                             | Two checks whose cases differ only in data, not in behavior, are one: a check whose removal loses no value or combination of values that the others cover goes.                                                            |
| Invariant | Unique                   | `inv.check-ids-unique`          |                             | No check ID is used twice.                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Invariant | In its section           | `inv.check-in-its-section`      |                             | A check's ID names the key of the catalogue section it sits in: the code span in the heading, or else the heading's Latin letters and digits in lowercase.                                                                 |
| Invariant | Well formed              | `inv.check-well-formed`         |                             | A check has concepts, GIVEN, WHEN, THEN and a proof: auto, judged or manual.                                                                                                                                               |
| Invariant | Checks before code       | `inv.required-concepts-checked` |                             | Every concept of a required class has a check, built or not.                                                                                                                                                               |
| Invariant | Automatic checks tested  | `inv.auto-check-tested`         |                             | Every automatic check whose concepts are all implemented has a test.                                                                                                                                                       |
| Invariant | Section keys match       | `inv.section-keys-match`        |                             | Each ontology section with definition rows has a key of its own, every catalogue section's key names one of them, and a key written in a heading is one code span of lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.                |
| Invariant | Judged checks tested     | `inv.judged-check-tested`       |                             | Every judged check whose concepts are all implemented has a test that runs it with a judge.                                                                                                                                |
| Invariant | Every axis value covered | `inv.axis-values-covered`       |                             | Every value of every axis is covered by a check, the outcome axis by each action's own checks, unless the catalogue says why the value cannot occur.                                                                       |
| Action    | Derive blind             | `action.derive-blind`           |                             | Someone who sees only the ontology and the catalogue says what should happen in a case the catalogue does not hold; a mismatch with the owner's answer adds a check, or an open question when the owner does not know.     |

| Check                               | Concepts                                                 | GIVEN                                                                                                           | WHEN                                                                         | THEN                                                                                                                                                                  | Proof  |
| ----------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------ |
| `check.check.duplicate`             | `inv.check-ids-unique`                                   | two catalogue rows share a check ID                                                                             | the check runs                                                               | it names the ID and fails                                                                                                                                             | auto   |
| `check.check.wrong-section`         | `inv.check-in-its-section`                               | `check.loan.cancel` sits under Hold                                                                             | the check runs                                                               | it names the check and its section, and fails                                                                                                                         | auto   |
| `check.check.section-key`           | `inv.check-in-its-section`                               | the Loan sections of the ontology and the catalogue are headed `Préstamo` with the key `loan` in a code span    | the check runs                                                               | `check.loan.*` sits in its section, and `--gap` lists its untested checks under that section                                                                          | auto   |
| `check.check.section-key-unmatched` | `inv.section-keys-match`                                 | the ontology's Hold section is headed `Reserva` without a key and the catalogue's `Reserva` with the key `hold` | the check runs, then `--gap` runs with a ticket that lists a hold check      | the check names the catalogue section and its key, and fails; `--gap` lists the check apart and counts it                                                             | auto   |
| `check.check.section-key-shared`    | `inv.section-keys-match`                                 | the ontology's Item section is headed `Item` with the key `loan`, beside the Loan section                       | the check runs                                                               | it names both sections and the key, and fails                                                                                                                         | auto   |
| `check.check.section-key-malformed` | `inv.section-keys-match`                                 | the Loan sections are headed `Loan` with `Loan V2` in a code span                                               | the check runs                                                               | it names the heading and fails                                                                                                                                        | auto   |
| `check.check.malformed`             | `inv.check-well-formed`                                  | a check's proof says "maybe"                                                                                    | the check runs                                                               | it names the check and fails                                                                                                                                          | auto   |
| `check.check.required-missing`      | `inv.required-concepts-checked`                          | an invariant has no check                                                                                       | the check runs                                                               | it names the invariant and fails                                                                                                                                      | auto   |
| `check.check.untested`              | `inv.auto-check-tested`                                  | an automatic check of implemented concepts has no test                                                          | the check runs                                                               | it names the check and fails                                                                                                                                          | auto   |
| `check.check.judged-untested`       | `inv.judged-check-tested`, `field.check.proof`           | a judged check whose concepts are implemented has no test that runs it with a judge                             | the check runs                                                               | it names the check and fails                                                                                                                                          | auto   |
| `check.check.axis-value-uncovered`  | `inv.axis-values-covered`, `concept.completeness-axis`   | `action.renew` has checks for success and for refusal only                                                      | the check runs                                                               | it names the outcomes the renewal lacks, empty, error and silence, and fails, unless the catalogue says why each cannot occur                                         | auto   |
| `check.check.product-terms`         | `rule.check-in-product-terms`                            | a new check                                                                                                     | a reviewer reads it                                                          | it names members, items and dates from the sample, and no function, command or selector                                                                               | manual |
| `check.check.unreachable-reported`  | `rule.unreachable-reported`, `rule.manual-evidence-kept` | a manual check that could not be run                                                                            | the run is reported                                                          | it says not run, and the evidence of the checks that ran is kept by check and date                                                                                    | manual |
| `check.check.chosen-value-held`     | `rule.chosen-value-checked`                              | a decision that chooses a value, a requirement or the assumptions of a model                                    | a reviewer reads the catalogue                                               | an automatic check holds the value or the requirement; for the model, a check holds a snapshot of its base scenario's results, and none requires it to reach its goal | manual |
| `check.check.judge-sees-the-check`  | `rule.judge-sees-the-check`                              | a judged check of a summary the product writes                                                                  | a reviewer reads its test                                                    | the judge gets the check's case and the summary, and neither the code nor an expected text                                                                            | manual |
| `check.check.verdict-kept`          | `rule.verdict-kept`                                      | a judged check that ran                                                                                         | the run is reported                                                          | its verdict is kept outside the repository, named by the check and the date                                                                                           | manual |
| `check.check.redundant`             | `rule.check-not-redundant`                               | two checks of `action.renew` whose cases differ only in the member and the title                                | a reviewer reads the catalogue                                               | one of them goes                                                                                                                                                      | manual |
| `check.check.blind-derivation`      | `action.derive-blind`                                    | a case the catalogue does not hold, with the owner's answer kept outside the catalogue                          | someone who sees only the ontology and the catalogue says what should happen | it matches the owner's answer; a mismatch adds a check, or an open question when the owner does not know the answer                                                   | manual |

## Test suite

| Kind      | Term                  | ID                            | Type                    | Definition                                                                                        |
