| Invariant | Covers its classes    | `inv.suite-covers-classes`    |                         | Every implemented concept of a covered class is proven by a test of the suite.                    |
| Invariant | Implements its checks | `inv.suite-implements-checks` |                         | Every check a suite names, of implemented concepts, is implemented by a test of that suite.       |

| Check                                  | Concepts                                                | GIVEN                                                                                    | WHEN           | THEN                                          | Proof |
| -------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------- | --------------------------------------------- | ----- |
| `check.test-suite.uncovered-concept`   | `inv.suite-covers-classes`                              | an implemented invariant has no test in the unit suite                                   | the check runs | it names the concept and the suite, and fails | auto  |
| `check.test-suite.unimplemented-check` | `inv.suite-implements-checks`, `edge.test-suite.checks` | the end-to-end suite names `check.loan.renew-twice`, and none of its tests implements it | the check runs | it names the check and the suite, and fails   | auto  |
| `check.test-suite.duplicate-name`      | `inv.suite-names-unique`                                | two suites are named unit                                                                | the check runs | it names the suite and fails                  | auto  |
| `check.test-suite.empty`               | `inv.suite-not-empty`                                   | a suite's directory has no test files                                                    | the check runs | it names the suite and fails                  | auto  |

## Ticket

| Kind      | Term                   | ID                             | Type                     | Definition                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| --------- | ---------------------- | ------------------------------ | ------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Entity    | Ticket                 | `ent.ticket`                   |                          | A slice of the gap: what to build now, within which limits.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Field     | Why now                | `field.ticket.why-now`         | text                     | Why this slice comes before the rest of the gap.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Field     | Out of scope           | `field.ticket.out-of-scope`    | text optional            | What not to build, though it is target too.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Field     | Pre-authorized         | `field.ticket.pre-authorized`  | text optional            | Permissions the agent would otherwise stop and ask for.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Relation  | Slice                  | `edge.ticket.concepts`         | refs ent.concept         | The concepts to build.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Relation  | Checks                 | `edge.ticket.checks`           | refs ent.check optional  | The checks of the slice, on the ticket's Checks: line.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Relation  | Depends on             | `edge.ticket.depends-on`       | refs ent.ticket optional | Slices that must be done first.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Derived   | Gap                    | `derived.gap`                  |                          | The work left: target concepts with their checks, automatic checks without a test, known divergences.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Derived   | Slice done             | `derived.slice-done`           |                          | Nothing of the slice left: its concepts implemented, its automatic checks tested, none of the checks it lists waiting for a concept outside it, and no known divergence that names only its concepts.                                                                                                                                   |
| Derived   | Readiness              | `derived.readiness`            |                          | What a target concept waits for: a ticket that takes it, an accepted deferral in force that names it, the owner while only tentative entries name it or an accepted entry naming it names a tentative one, or another target that its definition row or one of its checks names; otherwise it is ready. --gap shows it for each target. |
| Derived   | Next slice             | `derived.next-slice`           |                          | What --next proposes for the next ticket: the ready targets of the first ontology section that has any, the ready targets they depend on, and the checks whose concepts the slice and the code cover.                                                                                                                                   |
| Rule      | No behavior in tickets | `rule.ticket-without-behavior` |                          | A ticket does not describe behavior; behavior is in the check catalogue, written before the ticket.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Rule      | Build what is ready    | `rule.take-ready`              |                          | Work is taken from what --gap marks ready, through a ticket; a target that waits for the owner, a condition or another target is not built ahead of it.                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Rule      | Cut when started       | `rule.cut-when-started`        |                          | A ticket is cut when work on its slice starts, not ahead of it, because it takes its concepts out of what --next offers; an agent may cut it from --next, and what the agent may do then is the owner's choice                                                                                                                          |
| Rule      | Closed when done       | `rule.ticket-closed-on-done`   |                          | When --gap with the ticket prints SLICE_DONE and the tests pass, the ticket is closed and kept as the record of the slice                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| Rule      | Coordinator cuts       | `rule.coordinator-cuts`        |                          | When several agents work at once, one coordinator cuts all their tickets and commits them to the main branch before they start, since a ticket on another branch takes nothing that the others can see                                                                                                                                  |
| Rule      | One change per slice   | `rule.slice-one-change`        |                          | A slice is one change that a reviewer can read with its own evidence; when what --next proposes is more, it is split along its dependencies and the part the rest depends on is built first                                                                                                                                             |
| Invariant | Names its concepts     | `inv.ticket-has-ids`           |                          | A ticket has an IDs: line.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Invariant | Related checks         | `inv.ticket-checks-related`    |                          | Every check a ticket lists exists and names one of its concepts.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Action    | Cut a slice            | `action.cut-slice`             |                          | Take part of the gap and write the ticket with its limits and permissions.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |

| Check                             | Concepts                                        | GIVEN                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | WHEN                                              | THEN                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | Proof  |
| --------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------ |
| `check.ticket.no-ids`             | `inv.ticket-has-ids`                            | a ticket has no `IDs:` line                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | the check runs                                    | it names the ticket and fails                                                                                                                                                                                                            | auto   |
| `check.ticket.unknown-check`      | `inv.ticket-checks-related`                     | a ticket lists a check the catalogue does not have                                                                                                                                                                                               | the check runs                                    | it names the ticket and the check, and fails                                                                                                                                                                                             | auto   |
| `check.ticket.unrelated-check`    | `inv.ticket-checks-related`                     | a ticket lists a check that names none of its concepts                                                                                                                                                                                           | the check runs                                    | it names the ticket and the check, and fails                                                                                                                                                                                             | auto   |
| `check.ticket.slice-open`         | `derived.slice-done`, `derived.gap`             | a ticket whose concepts are not built                                                                                                                                                                                                            | `--gap` runs with the ticket                      | it lists them with their checks, prints `SLICE_OPEN` and exits 1                                                                                                                                                                         | auto   |
| `check.ticket.slice-done`         | `derived.slice-done`                            | a ticket whose concepts are built and whose checks are tested, with no divergence of its own                                                                                                                                                     | `--gap` runs with the ticket                      | it prints `SLICE_DONE` and exits 0                                                                                                                                                                                                       | auto   |
| `check.ticket.own-divergence`     | `derived.slice-done`                            | a ticket whose concepts are built and whose checks are tested, and a known divergence that names only its concepts                                                                                                                               | `--gap` runs with the ticket                      | it shows the divergence, prints `SLICE_OPEN: 1` and exits 1                                                                                                                                                                              | auto   |
| `check.ticket.shared-divergence`  | `derived.slice-done`                            | a ticket whose concepts are built and whose checks are tested, and a known divergence that names one of its concepts and one outside it                                                                                                          | `--gap` runs with the ticket                      | it shows the divergence apart, does not count it, and prints `SLICE_DONE`                                                                                                                                                                | auto   |
| `check.ticket.check-waits`        | `derived.slice-done`                            | a ticket whose concepts are built lists a check that also needs a concept outside the slice, not built yet                                                                                                                                       | `--gap` runs with the ticket                      | it names the check and the concept it waits for, prints `SLICE_OPEN: 1` and exits 1                                                                                                                                                      | auto   |
| `check.ticket.judged-check-waits` | `derived.slice-done`, `inv.judged-check-tested` | a ticket whose concepts are built lists a judged check that also needs a concept outside the slice, not built yet                                                                                                                                | `--gap` runs with the ticket                      | it names the check and the concept it waits for, prints `SLICE_OPEN: 1` and exits 1                                                                                                                                                      | auto   |
| `check.ticket.checks-line-only`   | `edge.ticket.checks`                            | a ticket names, under out of scope, a check that names none of its concepts                                                                                                                                                                      | the check runs, then `--gap` runs with the ticket | the check passes, and `--gap` neither shows nor counts that check                                                                                                                                                                        | auto   |
| `check.ticket.gap-readiness`      | `derived.readiness`                             | `action.cancel-hold` is in no ticket and no entry names it, `rule.pickup-window` is in ticket 0003, a tentative entry names `hook.due-reminder`, an accepted deferral names `view.catalog`, and a check of `view.desk` also names `view.catalog` | `--gap` runs                                      | it marks them ready, in ticket 0003, waiting for the owner, deferred until the condition, and waiting for `view.catalog`                                                                                                                 | auto   |
| `check.ticket.next-slice`         | `derived.next-slice`                            | the example, whose first ready target is `action.set-borrow-limit` in the Member section                                                                                                                                                         | `--next` runs                                     | it prints `NEXT · Member` with `action.set-borrow-limit` on the IDs line and `check.member.set-borrow-limit` on the Checks line; with nothing ready, it says what the targets wait for, and with no target left, what else the gap holds | auto   |
| `check.ticket.no-behavior`        | `rule.ticket-without-behavior`                  | a ticket                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | a reviewer reads it                               | it lists concepts and checks; any behavior it needs is already in the catalogue                                                                                                                                                          | manual |
| `check.ticket.take-ready`         | `rule.take-ready`                               | an agent looks for work                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | it takes the next slice                           | the slice holds ready targets only, cut into a ticket from `--next`; a target that waits for the owner is left until the owner answers                                                                                                   | manual |
| `check.ticket.cut-when-started`   | `rule.cut-when-started`                         | the tickets open in a project                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | a reviewer reads them                             | each is being worked on now; none was cut ahead to hold concepts for later, and an agent that cut one did only what the owner allows                                                                                                     | manual |
| `check.ticket.closed-on-done`     | `rule.ticket-closed-on-done`                    | a ticket whose `--gap` prints `SLICE_DONE` and whose tests pass                                                                                                                                                                                  | a reviewer looks for it                           | it is closed, and its file or its tracker entry is still there                                                                                                                                                                           | manual |
| `check.ticket.coordinator-cuts`   | `rule.coordinator-cuts`                         | several agents start work at the same time, each on a branch of its own                                                                                                                                                                          | a reviewer reads the tickets they work from       | one coordinator cut them all, they were on the main branch before the agents started, and no concept is in two of them                                                                                                                   | manual |
| `check.ticket.one-change`         | `rule.slice-one-change`                         | a ticket cut from what `--next` proposed                                                                                                                                                                                                         | a reviewer reads the change that closes it        | it is one change the reviewer can follow with its tests; if not, the ticket should have been split along the dependencies, the part the rest depends on first                                                                            | manual |

## Agent rules

| Kind      | Term                           | ID                                  | Type | Definition                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| --------- | ------------------------------ | ----------------------------------- | ---- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Entity    | Agent rules                    | `ent.agent-rules`                   |      | The section of the agents' instructions that says what else to update when something changes, and what to run.                                                                                                                                    |
| Field     | Files                          | `field.agent-rules.files`           | text | The files that hold the agents' instructions, listed in the configuration under agentInstructions; the check reads the IDs and entries they mention.                                                                                              |
| Concept   | Approach IDs                   | `concept.approach-ids`              |      | The approach's concept IDs and retired IDs, generated into tools/ont-check/approach.json and copied with the tool, so that a project's check resolves the rules of the approach.                                                                  |
| Rule      | Short                          | `rule.agent-rules-short`            |      | The section is short enough to be read at the start of every session.                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Rule      | Points at files                | `rule.agent-rules-point-at-files`   |      | Every row names a path or a command.                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Rule      | Start from IDs                 | `rule.start-from-ids`               |      | Every task starts by naming the IDs it touches; a task that cannot is not about meaning, or the ontology is incomplete.                                                                                                                           |
| Rule      | Findings that matter           | `rule.findings-mislead`             |      | A consistency review reports what would mislead a reader or an agent, or would break a check. Style, the completeness of lists and compliance that changes nothing are not findings.                                                              |
| Rule      | Every change committed         | `rule.commit-finished-work`         |      | Every change ends with a commit of its own files; who approves a commit or a push is the user's choice.                                                                                                                                           |
| Rule      | Rule names its source          | `rule.agent-rule-source`            |      | A process rule in the agent instructions that comes from a rule of the approach or from a decision names that rule's ID or that entry; commands and matters of style name nothing.                                                                |
| Rule      | Departure by entry             | `rule.departure-by-entry`           |      | A project departs from a rule of the approach, stricter or looser, only by a process entry that extends or overrides it, and the instruction that departs cites that entry.                                                                       |
| Rule      | Strongest step                 | `rule.strongest-step`               |      | A correction of an agent is held at the strongest step that can hold it: the structure of the code, so the mistake cannot be written; then a check of the tool, a test or a lint; then a rule in the agent instructions; a reviewer's memory last |
| Invariant | Instruction references resolve | `inv.agent-rule-references-resolve` |      | Every concept ID the agent instructions mention is defined, in the project's ontology or the approach's, and not retired; every entry they cite exists and is in force.                                                                           |
| Invariant | Approach IDs current           | `inv.approach-ids-current`          |      | The generated approach IDs match the approach's ontology.                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Action    | Critique a change              | `action.critique-change`            |      | Review a significant change as an agent that did not write it, from the diff and the IDs it touches, without the author's conclusions.                                                                                                            |

| Check                                    | Concepts                                                       | GIVEN                                                                                       | WHEN                                                  | THEN                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | Proof  |
| ---------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------ |
| `check.agent-rules.unknown-id`           | `inv.agent-rule-references-resolve`, `field.agent-rules.files` | `AGENTS.md` mentions a rule ID that neither the project's ontology nor the approach defines | the check runs                                        | it names the ID and the file, and fails                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | auto   |
| `check.agent-rules.retired-id`           | `inv.agent-rule-references-resolve`                            | `AGENTS.md` mentions an ID that the project or the approach has retired                     | the check runs                                        | it names the ID and what replaced it, and fails                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | auto   |
| `check.agent-rules.unknown-entry`        | `inv.agent-rule-references-resolve`                            | `AGENTS.md` cites D-63, which the log does not have, and D-04, which D-07 supersedes        | the check runs                                        | it names D-63 as missing and D-04 as superseded by D-07, and fails                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | auto   |
| `check.agent-rules.approach-ids-stale`   | `inv.approach-ids-current`, `concept.approach-ids`             | a concept was added to the approach's ontology and `approach.json` was not generated again  | the check runs                                        | it names `approach.json` and fails; after `gen-approach.mjs` it passes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | auto   |
| `check.agent-rules.short-and-concrete`   | `rule.agent-rules-short`, `rule.agent-rules-point-at-files`    | the agent rules section                                                                     | a reviewer reads it                                   | it fits on one screen and every row names a path or a command                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | manual |
| `check.agent-rules.start-from-ids`       | `rule.start-from-ids`                                          | a task for an agent                                                                         | the agent starts                                      | it names the IDs the task touches before writing code                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | manual |
| `check.agent-rules.findings-that-matter` | `rule.findings-mislead`                                        | a consistency review of a project                                                           | a reviewer reads its findings                         | each one says who would be misled or which check would break; style, list completeness and compliance that changes nothing are left out                                                                                                                                                                          | manual |
| `check.agent-rules.commit-finished-work` | `rule.commit-finished-work`                                    | an agent accepted a decision entry as part of a change                                      | the change is done                                    | the change is in a commit of its own files and no one else's, so the guard protects the entry; whether the commit or a push waited for an approval is the user's choice                                                                                                                                          | manual |
| `check.agent-rules.critique-change`      | `action.critique-change`                                       | a change to a rule of the approach                                                          | it is reviewed                                        | the reviewer did not write it and got the diff and the IDs it touches, not the author's conclusions                                                                                                                                                                                                              | manual |
| `check.agent-rules.rule-names-source`    | `rule.agent-rule-source`, `rule.departure-by-entry`            | a process rule in the agent instructions, such as one that says agents do not commit        | a reviewer reads it                                   | it names the rule of the approach or the entry it comes from, and a rule that departs from the approach cites a process entry that extends or overrides it. The tool cannot tell a process rule from a command or a matter of style, nor whether a rule written in prose is stricter or looser than the approach | manual |
| `check.agent-rules.strongest-step`       | `rule.strongest-step`                                          | an agent was corrected for a mistake it could make again                                    | a reviewer reads the change that holds the correction | it is held by the structure of the code, a check, a test or a lint where one of them can hold it; a rule in the agent instructions only where none can, and the rule says so                                                                                                                                     | manual |

| `check.doc-section.not-an-id`                | `inv.anchors-resolve`                             | an anchor says `Place hold` instead of an ID                                                                  | the check runs                                                          | it names the page and the text, and fails                                         | auto   |
| `check.doc-section.reread-after-change`      | `derived.to-reread`                               | a definition changed after a section anchored to it was stamped                                               | the check runs, the section is reread and stamped, the check runs again | the first run lists the section as information; the second does not               | auto   |
| `check.doc-section.reread-after-note-change` | `derived.to-reread`                               | a note under a definition table that names `action.return` changed after a section anchored to it was stamped | the check runs                                                          | it lists the section as information                                               | auto   |
| `check.doc-section.anchored`                 | `rule.anchor-every-section`, `rule.readers-words` | a page of a doc set                                                                                           | a reviewer reads it                                                     | every section that explains a concept has an anchor, and none copies a definition | manual |
| `check.doc-section.reread-before-stamp`      | `rule.reread-then-stamp`                          | sections listed to reread                                                                                     | someone stamps them                                                     | they reread each section first and fixed what changed                             | manual |
| `check.doc-section.guide-runs-check`         | `rule.guide-runs-check`                           | a section of a run guide                                                                                      | someone who has not seen the product follows it                         | they run the check, and the section names the check without restating its case    | manual |
